notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Burakos triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose at least three life.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
